title: Otter in a little scarf
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- water line -->
  <rect x="2" y="72" width="96" height="26" rx="6" fill="#1f5f8b"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="46" ry="6" fill="#2f7fb8"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="26" ry="20" fill="#8a5a33"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="64" rx="18" ry="15" fill="#c08955"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="38" r="19" fill="#8a5a33"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="26" r="6" fill="#7a4c28"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="26" r="6" fill="#7a4c28"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="26" r="3" fill="#c08955"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="26" r="3" fill="#c08955"/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="45" rx="13" ry="10" fill="#e0b784"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="35" r="3.6" fill="#2b1c10"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="35" r="3.6" fill="#2b1c10"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="34" r="1.3" fill="#eafaff"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="34" r="1.3" fill="#eafaff"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="4.2" ry="3.2" fill="#3a2416"/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d="M44 48 Q50 53 56 48" fill="none" stroke="#7a4c28" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d="M36 44 L26 42 M36 47 L26 49 M64 44 L74 42 M64 47 L74 49" stroke="#e8cba0" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <!-- paws holding -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="66" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#8a5a33"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="66" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#8a5a33"/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d="M28 54 Q50 64 72 54 Q72 62 50 68 Q28 62 28 54 Z" fill="#e04a4a"/>
  <path d="M60 62 L66 78 L56 80 L52 64 Z" fill="#f06a6a"/>
  <path d="M60 62 L66 78" stroke="#c03a3a" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none"/>
  <!-- scarf stripes -->
  <path d="M36 57 Q50 64 64 57" stroke="#ffd27a" stroke-width="2.4" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M61 66 L64 74" stroke="#ffd27a" stroke-width="2.2" fill="none"/>
</svg>
